sentences.l2: 近年来，越来越多的家庭把新能源车纳入购车计划。
sentences.l1: In recent years, more and more families have put new energy vehicles into their car-buying plans.

sentences.l2: 除了环保理念的推动，限号政策的压力与购车补贴的诱惑，也让不少人下定决心。
sentences.l1: Besides the push of environmental awareness, the pressure of number-based driving restriction policies and the temptation of purchase subsidies have also made quite a few people make up their minds.

sentences.l2: 然而，真正进入决策阶段时，续航焦虑往往成为最大的心理障碍。
sentences.l1: However, when they truly enter the decision stage, range anxiety often becomes the biggest psychological obstacle.

sentences.l2: 厂商宣传的续航里程多是在理想工况下测得的，而实际驾驶中，冬季低温、空调能耗与高速行驶都会大幅折损这一数字，标称五百公里的车型，可能只跑三百余公里便需寻找电源。
sentences.l1: The range advertised by manufacturers is mostly measured under ideal operating conditions, whereas in actual driving, low winter temperatures, air conditioning energy consumption and high-speed driving will all sharply reduce this figure, and a model rated at five hundred kilometres may run only a little over three hundred kilometres before needing to find a power source.

sentences.l2: 更棘手的是充电桩的分布问题。
sentences.l1: What is even more troublesome is the distribution of charging stations.

sentences.l2: 老城区车位紧张，私人桩安装困难，车主只能依赖公共充电设施；而节假日期间，热门服务区的充电桩前常排起长队，等待时间甚至超过充电本身。
sentences.l1: In old urban districts parking spaces are tight and installing private chargers is difficult, so car owners can only rely on public charging facilities; and during holidays, long queues often form in front of the chargers at popular service areas, and the waiting time even exceeds the charging itself.

sentences.l2: 因此，理性购车者会先摸清住所与通勤路线沿线的充电条件，再权衡补贴力度与车型性能，而非仅仅被低价或新颖的外观所吸引。
sentences.l1: Therefore, rational car buyers will first find out the charging conditions along their residence and commuting route, and then weigh the strength of subsidies against the performance of the model, rather than being attracted merely by a low price or a novel appearance.
